setup.heading: Set up profile
setup.intro: Only your username is required. You can change both names later in Settings.
setup.penNameNotSaved: Your username is saved, but not the pen name. You can add it in Settings.

handle.label: Username
handle.hint: 3 to 30 characters. Any characters work, but we block swearwords, names that look like our staff’s and look-alike letters that copy another name. People use it to find and mention you.
handle.checkFailed: We couldn’t check this name right now. We’ll check again when you save.

outcomes.invisible_characters: Remove the invisible characters. They’re used to fake names.
outcomes.spaces: A username can’t have spaces. Try a dot or an underscore instead.
outcomes.looks_like_staff: This username looks like a staff name. Try another one.
outcomes.reserved: One of our pages uses this name. Try another one.
outcomes.not_allowed: This username isn’t allowed. Try another one.
outcomes.taken: Someone already has this username, or one that looks the same.
outcomes.too_soon: You can change your username once every {{days}} days.

penName.label: Pen name (optional)
penName.hint: Shown on your stories instead of your username. You can change it once every {{days}} days. We never ask for your real name.

outcomes.invisible_characters: Remove the invisible characters. They’re used to fake names.
outcomes.looks_like_staff: This pen name looks like a staff name. Try another one.
outcomes.not_allowed: This pen name isn’t allowed. Try another one.
outcomes.too_soon: You can change your pen name once every {{days}} days.

falseHit.text: Think we got this wrong, for example because it’s your surname?
falseHit.link: Ask a moderator to check it

settings.heading: Settings
settings.usernameHint: People find you by this. You can change it once every {{days}} days.
settings.penNameHint: Shown on your stories instead of your username. Leave it empty to show your username. You can change it once every {{days}} days.
settings.nextChange: You can change it again on {{date}}.
settings.legalText: The terms of use, the privacy notice and the community guidelines, with every earlier version.

notice.heading: Choose a username
notice.body: You need a username before you can publish, comment or post. It only takes a moment.

errors.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your account. Check your connection and try again.
errors.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Check your connection and try again.

devices.heading: Signed-in devices
devices.body: Where you’re logged in right now. If you don’t recognise a device, log it out and change your password.
devices.privacy: We show the browser and the kind of device only. We don’t keep your IP address or where you are.
devices.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your devices. Check your connection and try again.
devices.actionFailed: That didn’t work. Check your connection and try again.
devices.lagNote: A device you log out can’t renew its access; it may stay open for up to an hour.

country.label: Country you live in
country.note: The law where you live sets some ages, such as when a parent has to agree.
country.saved: Saved. The rules where you live now apply.
country.consentNeeded: Saved. Where you live, a parent or guardian needs to agree because of your age. Ask them by {{date}}. Until then you can keep writing.

failures.under_country_age: People your age can’t use {{productName}} in that country, so we didn’t change it.
failures.unknown_country: Choose a country from the list.
failures.unreachable: We couldn’t save your country. Check your connection and try again.

suspension.title: Account suspended until {{until}}.
suspension.body: You can read and download your data, but you can’t publish, comment or message until then.

reporting_pause.title: Reporting paused until {{until}}.
reporting_pause.body: Reports you sent were found unfounded again and again, so reporting is paused for a while. You can still read and write.

email.heading: Email address
email.private: Only you can see it. It’s never on your profile or shown to other people.
email.pending: Waiting to change to {{email}}. Type the two codes we sent to finish.
email.newHint: We’ll send a 6-digit code to your current address and another to the new one. The change happens once you type both.
email.sent: Check both inboxes: we sent a code to {{email}} and another to your current address. Until you type both, your current address keeps working.
email.sameAddress: That’s already the address on this account.
email.invalidAddress: That doesn’t look like an email address. Check it and try again.
email.addressInUse: Another account already uses this address.
email.tooManyAttempts: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
email.changeFailed: We couldn’t send the codes. Check your connection and try again.
email.wrongCode: This code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or send new codes.
email.codesCheckFailed: We couldn’t check the codes. Check your connection and try again.
email.changed: Done. The email address is now {{email}}.

birthday.heading: Birthday
birthday.intro: Add your birthday month if you’d like a greeting: we say happy birthday month all month. We ask for the month only, never the day, so it can’t make a full date of birth with your year of birth.
birthday.private: Only you can see it. Your year of birth from sign-up stays as it is and can’t be changed.
birthday.saveFailed: We couldn’t save your birthday. Check your connection and try again.

ageCheck.heading: Confirm age
ageCheck.intro13: We check that you’re 13 or over, and whether you’re under 18, so you get the right safety settings.
ageCheck.intro18: We check that you’re 18 or over, so you get the settings for adults.
ageCheck.methodsIntro: You choose one on Yoti’s page.
ageCheck.selfieBody: Yoti estimates your age from a photo, then deletes it.
ageCheck.documentBody: Use your ID card or passport. Use this if you’d rather not take a selfie, or if the selfie check didn’t work.
ageCheck.startHint: Takes you to Yoti’s page. When you’re done, you come back here.
ageCheck.keptBody: the result (for example “13 or over”), the date and which method you used. Never your photo or your document.
ageCheck.step2: You take a selfie or scan your ID there.
ageCheck.step3: You come back here and see your result.
ageCheck.readOnly: Until the check is done, you can read but not post.
ageCheck.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your age check. Try again in a moment.
ageCheck.nothingToDo: There’s no age check to do right now.
ageCheck.birthYearInSettings: Year of birth is in Settings.
ageCheck.photoDeleted: Yoti deleted the photo after the check.

errors.signed_out: Your session ended. Log in again to check your age.
errors.not_needed: There’s no age check to do right now.
errors.unavailable: The age check isn’t available right now. Try again later.
errors.unreachable: We couldn’t reach the age check. Check your connection and try again.

return.checkingBody: We’re waiting for the result from Yoti. This can take a moment. Keep this page open.
return.adultYearBody: Settings for adults need an “18 or over” result. You can get one with an ID document.
return.failedBody: The check didn’t give a clear result. You can try again, or use an ID document instead.
return.notFinishedBody: The Yoti page was closed or ran out of time. Nothing from it was kept. Start a new check when you’re ready.
return.cancelledBody: You left Yoti’s page before the check finished. Nothing from it was kept. Start a new check when you’re ready.

notice.heading: Confirm age
notice.body: Until your age is confirmed, you can read but not post.

ageCheck.fourteenDays: If it isn’t done within 14 days of joining, we delete the account and your year (and month) of birth.

manual.askLine: Ask for a manual check. A person checks it and replies within 5 working days. They never see a photo.
manual.askFailed: We couldn’t send your request. Try again in a moment.
manual.openTitle: A person is checking the age.
manual.openBody: They reply within 5 working days. Your account stays read-only until then.
manual.refusedTitle: We couldn’t confirm the age by hand.
manual.refusedBody: The reason: {{reason}} You can start a new check with Yoti.

parentConsent.heading: Ask a parent or guardian
parentConsent.intro: You’re under 16, so a parent or guardian needs to agree. We’ll email them a link.
parentConsent.sentHeading: We emailed your parent or guardian
parentConsent.sentBody: We sent a link to {{email}}. They need to open it and say yes.
parentConsent.opensAfter: Publishing, comments, forum posts and messages open after they say yes.
parentConsent.deadline: If nobody says yes by {{date}}, we delete your account and its data.
parentConsent.agreedBody: Your parent or guardian agreed on {{date}}. You can now publish, comment, post and send messages.
parentConsent.withdrawnHeading: Your parent or guardian withdrew their consent
parentConsent.withdrawnBody: Your account is read-only for now: you can read, but not publish, comment, post or send messages. We’ll tell you and them what happens next.
parentConsent.nothingToDo: There’s nothing to ask a parent or guardian for right now.
parentConsent.signedOut: Log in to ask a parent or guardian.
parentConsent.loadFailed: We couldn’t load this page. Try again in a moment.

failures.signed_out: Log in again, then send the email.
failures.own_email: That’s your own email. Use your parent’s or guardian’s.
failures.too_soon: Wait a minute before sending again.
failures.not_needed: There’s nothing to ask a parent or guardian for right now.
failures.unavailable: We couldn’t send the email. Try again in a moment.

notice.heading: Ask a parent or guardian
notice.body: Because of your age and where you live, a parent or guardian needs to agree before you can publish, comment, post or send messages.
notice.withdrawnBody: Your account is read-only from now on. You can still read stories, keep your library, report anything that worries you and download your data, and your own stories stay saved. You can’t publish, comment, post or send messages unless a parent or guardian agrees again.
notice.graceBody: The rules where you live now ask a parent or guardian to agree, because of your age. Ask them by {{date}}. Until then you can keep writing; after that your account is read-only until they agree.

parent.heading: Your child wants to join {{productName}}
parent.intro: Someone signed up with {{email}} as @{{handle}} and gave your email as their parent or guardian. They told us they were born in {{year}}, and they passed an age check. Their account stays limited until you answer.
parent.whatBody: A free place to write and read stories, poems and essays. Writers keep the rights to their work.
parent.keepBody: Their email, their username, a pen name if they choose one, their year of birth (and birth month, if we needed it) and the age check result. We never ask for their real name.
parent.protectMessages: Adults can never message anyone under 16. If they’re 16 or 17, messages from adults are off unless they turn them on.
parent.protectReports: They can block and report anyone. A person reads every report.
parent.protectRatings: Stories are rated All ages, 13+, 16+ or 18+. Your child only sees stories rated for their age.
parent.protectAds: Ads match the page and are the same for everyone. They never use your child’s profile.
parent.legalIntro: Read these before you answer. Both are in Romanian and English.
parent.guardian: I’m this child’s parent or legal guardian.
parent.guardianNeeded: Tick that you’re the parent or legal guardian first.
parent.deadline: If you don’t answer by {{date}}, we delete the account and its data.
parent.agreedBody: @{{handle}} can now publish, comment, post and send messages. We emailed you a confirmation. You can withdraw your consent here at any time.
parent.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw your consent? The account becomes read-only straight away.
parent.refusedBody: We won’t activate this account, and we’ve deleted it and its data.
parent.withdrawnBody: @{{handle}}’s account is read-only. If you have questions about what happens next, write to us.
parent.goneBody: A newer email may have replaced it, or the account was deleted. If you think this is wrong, write to us.
parent.spotlightBox: Optional: you may also suggest my child and their stories to other readers.
parent.spotlightHint: For example in New and rising writers. Leave it unticked and nothing changes for the account. You can say yes later, or take it back at any time.

summary.heading: What your parent or guardian agreed to
summary.agreedOn: Your parent or guardian agreed on {{date}}.
summary.coversWrite: You can publish stories, comment and post in the forums.
summary.coversMessages: You can send and get private messages, within the rules for your age: adults can never message anyone under 16.
summary.coversData: We keep your email, username, pen name, year of birth and age check result, and never your real name.
summary.coversWithdraw: They can withdraw their yes at any time. If they do, your account becomes read-only and we tell you here.
summary.withdrawnOn: Your parent or guardian withdrew their consent on {{date}}.
summary.stillIntro: Your account is read-only for now. You can still:
summary.stillRead: read stories and keep a library;
summary.stillKept: find your own stories, saved as they were;
summary.stillReport: report anything that worries you, and block anyone;
summary.stillData: download your data or delete your account, below.

spotlight.heading: May we suggest your child to other readers?
spotlight.intro: @{{handle}} would like us to suggest them and their stories to other readers. They’re under 16, so we only do this if you say yes.
spotlight.whereShown: Where: in lists such as New and rising writers and Writers to follow.
spotlight.whatShown: What readers see: their username or pen name, their avatar and the stories they’ve published.
spotlight.whatNot: Never their email, their age or anything private. Saying no changes nothing else about their account.
spotlight.agreedNow: You said yes, so readers may see @{{handle}} among our suggestions.
spotlight.noAnswer: You can change your mind at any time from this page.

onboarding.heading: Set up profile
onboarding.intro: Three short steps. Only your username is required. You can skip the rest and change it later in Settings.
onboarding.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Try again in a moment.
onboarding.loadFailed: We couldn’t load your profile. Try again in a moment.

name.heading: Name and language
name.languageHint: The language of menus and buttons. {{productName}} opens in Romanian for everyone. If you’d rather use English, pick it here or from the language menu. It applies on every device you use.
name.countryBody: We work out your country from your connection, so we don’t ask. You can see it in Settings.
name.regionHint: Only if you choose it. We use it only for the “Popular in your area” shelf. We never track where you are.

likes.heading: What do you like?
likes.intro: Pick as many as you want. We use your picks only to fill your home screen, and you can change them in Settings.
likes.noTopics: There are no topics to pick yet.

safety.heading: Staying safe here
safety.blockBody: Open their profile or your chat, then press Block. They can’t message, mention or follow you, and they aren’t told.
safety.reportBody: Every story, comment, post and message has a Report button. A person reads every report.
safety.messagesUnder16: Adults can never message anyone under 16. Nothing can change that.
safety.messagesTeenBody: If you’re 16 or 17, messages from adults are off unless you turn them on. Change this any time in Settings.
safety.guidelineKind: Be kind. No bullying, threats or hate.
safety.guidelineOwnWork: Post your own work. You’re responsible for what you publish.
safety.guidelinePrivate: Keep your address, school and phone number private.
safety.guidelineRate: Rate your stories: All ages, 13+, 16+ or 18+.

notice.heading: Finish setting up your profile
notice.body: Pick your language and what you like, so Discover shows you more of it. It takes a minute, and you can skip any step.

settings.heading: What you like
settings.intro: Your county and the picks that fill “Picked for you” on Discover. Only you see them.

teacherBadge.heading: Are you a teacher?
teacherBadge.intro: Get a Teacher badge and you can create private class spaces for your students. Only you and students with your invite code can see a class space. You can skip this and do it later.
teacherBadge.wayLegend: How do you want to show you teach?

school_email.title: Confirm a school email
school_email.text: The quickest way. We send a link to your school address. Open it to get your badge.

proof.title: Upload proof that you teach
proof.text: A letter from your school or your staff card. Our team checks it, usually within two working days.

email.label: School email address
email.hint: Use the address your school gave you, for example one ending in .edu.ro or your school’s own website name. Personal addresses like Gmail don’t count.

status.not_email: This doesn’t look like an email address yet.
status.personal: This looks like a personal address. Use your school one, or upload proof instead.
status.other: We’ll check this address belongs to a school.

proof.label: Proof that you teach
proof.hint: A letter from your school or a photo of your staff card. JPG, PNG or PDF, up to 10 MB.
proof.whatText: We only use it to check that you teach. Once the check is done, we delete it.
proof.untilThen: Until then your account works as normal and your badge shows as

teacherBadge.linkSent: Link sent to {{email}}. Open it on any device to get your badge. Can’t find it? Check your spam folder.
teacherBadge.proofSent: Thanks, we’ve got it. Our team usually checks it within two working days. Your account works as normal while you wait, and we’ll notify you when it’s done.

failures.signed_out: Log in again, then try once more.
failures.invalid: This doesn’t look like an email address yet.
failures.personal_address: This looks like a personal address. Use your school one, or upload proof instead.
failures.not_available: You can’t ask for a Teacher badge right now.
failures.too_soon: Wait a minute before sending another link.
failures.unavailable: We couldn’t send it. Try again in a few minutes.
failures.wrong_type: Choose a JPG, PNG or PDF file.
failures.too_big: This file is bigger than 10 MB. Choose a smaller one.

settings.heading: Teacher badge
settings.intro: With a Teacher badge you can create private class spaces for your students. It shows as “Teacher” on your profile.
settings.have: You’ve had the Teacher badge since {{date}}.
settings.waitingForStaff: Our team is checking your request. We’ll notify you when it’s done.
settings.linkWaiting: We sent a link to your address at {{domain}}. Open it to get your badge. It works until {{date}}.
settings.rejected: Your last request wasn’t approved. Our team said: “{{reason}}”
settings.tryAgain: You can try again with another school address or with proof.
settings.removed: Your Teacher badge was removed. You can ask for it again.

confirm.approved: It shows on the profile, and class spaces can now be opened.
confirm.waiting_for_staff: A moderator now checks that the address belongs to a school. The answer arrives in notifications.
confirm.expired: Ask for a new one in Settings.
confirm.gone: It may have been used already, or a newer one was sent.
confirm.failed: Try again in a few minutes.

headings.gone: This link doesn’t work any more

steps.badgeNote: Then class spaces can be opened

holding.heading: You’re on the list
holding.next: We let people in a few at a time, writers first. When your place comes up, we’ll email you to say you’re in. Until then you can’t write, read or post yet, but you can get your profile ready.
holding.nextClosed: We’re not open in {{country}} yet. Once it opens, we’ll email you to say you’re in. Until then you can’t write, read or post yet, but you can get your profile ready.
holding.nextClosedUnknown: We’re not open in your country yet. Once it opens, we’ll email you to say you’re in. Until then you can’t write, read or post yet, but you can get your profile ready.
holding.interestLabel: What do you want to do here?
holding.saveFailed: We couldn’t save that. Check your connection and try again.
holding.logOutFailed: We couldn’t log you out. Check your connection and try again.
